doc.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: Pearl Harbor eve opening and touring theaters with Jimmy Durante
summary: Opening the day before the war began, theater tours by train with Durante and Mildred Bailey.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: What about the war years? Did you go in the service?

Well the day after we opened at the Blue Gardens with Red, that was December 6, 1941. So the war started the next day. But we did travel, we traveled in the midwest, did a lot of theaters. And Jimmy Durante was, he did twelve weeks with us. But at that point you couldn’t get gas so we had to travel by train. We had our own car — I mean car on the train, you know what I mean?
Sure. A Pullman type? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-
